Re-verified the reporting window auto-resolves to Mon 2026-06-22 to Sun 2026-06-28. Investigated publishing the 237 KB master into ph_task id 8 via MCP chunked splice and confirmed the MCP-by-hand limit (unique ~180 KB data block exceeds faithful transcription / tool-output limits); id 8 left partial (template head + 2 verified data chunks) rather than corrupt.
